feature_mapping: Exact shared names only; extraction/calibration equivalence not established
source_fit: All source observations, inner 3-fold StratifiedGroupKFold, 8 hikers x10 iterations; source-only utility/imputation/scaling/SMOTE
budget: One of three common columns, equal synthetic costs; EHOA unconstrained comparator
target_use: Prediction and evaluation only; no target fitting, tuning or feature selection
subject_unit: Mean predicted probability across three target recordings; threshold >=0.5
bootstrap: 10000 stratified subject resamples seed20261013, descriptive 95% intervals for five-seed mean-probability ensemble per method
scope: Exploratory external public-dataset transfer on a restricted common feature space; not original 22-feature model validation or prospective clinical validation
